headline: Small SE dribble on an onshore day — not much to work with.
today: Swell's only knee-high and mostly short-period, and the wind is onshore from dawn, building from 10 to 20mph SSE through the day. There's no clean window here — it just gets worse as it goes. If you're desperate, dawn is the least-bad option before the S wind fills in, but honestly this is a skip.

daysToWatch.note: Swell jumps to chest-high plus (2.6-3.7ft) at a good SE angle with light cross winds early — dawn W turning to 5mph SW. That's the window. Grab the groveler or fish before the afternoon onshore kills it.
Smaller (1.6-2ft) but clean with N/NNW offshore all day. Fun little log or groveler session, best on the morning tide.
